title: Haye Sughra Kivey Joundi Rehgayi Baaj
body:
Ghazi Deray Laye Kyun Nehar Kinarey
Duniya Ton Pyasay Turgaye x2 Malik Daryawan Dey
<<DIVIDER>>
Pairaan De Vich Chalay Gal Tauq Vi Bahri
Sir Tak Tak Rovay Zakhmi x2 Phupiyan Tey Mavan Ney
<<DIVIDER>>
Akthar Hurmal Nu Koyi Ja ke
Samjaye
Ki Milna Ey Zalim Tenu Zulm Kama Key
Asghar Jey Baal Nayi Hondey x2 Haye Laik Sazavan Dey
